verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Sāriputta was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anuruddho rattiyā paccūsasamayaṁ paccuṭṭhāya dhammapadāni bhāsati.
verses.english: Now at that time Venerable Anuruddha rose at the crack of dawn and recited passages of the teaching.

verses.pali: Atha kho piyaṅkaramātā yakkhinī puttakaṁ evaṁ tosesi:
verses.english: Then the native spirit Piyaṅkara’s Mother soothed her little child, saying:
A mendicant recites passages of the teaching.
we can practice for our welfare.
Let us restrain ourselves from harming living creatures,
We should train ourselves well in ethics,
and hopefully we’ll be freed from the goblin realm.”
